tagline: Room to sprawl on soft fibre and faux fur, with all four sides left open.
lead: Your dog can stretch out full length on a soft faux-fur surface, with no sides in the way.
value: A finish you will like in the room too: grey herringbone outside, faux fur where they sleep, and covers that come off to wash.
intro: Sedge is an open pillow dog mattress in grey herringbone, with a faux-fur sleeping surface, soft virgin fibre filling, leather handles, a non-slip base and removable covers. Medium and Large.
points: An open mattress with all four sides clear, so they can lie however they like.
Virgin fibre filling is gentler underfoot than a firm foam slab. This is not a memory foam mattress.
Soft faux fur where they sleep, with herringbone on the outside.
Washable covers come off, leather handles help you move it, and the base is non-slip.
best_for: Sprawlers who like to lie full length and prefer soft fibre cushioning and faux fur to a firm foam mattress.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and allow 15–20cm extra. With no sides, the whole surface is theirs. If a measurement is unclear, ask us before ordering.
care: Take the cover off and follow the sewn-in washing instructions. Let it air-dry fully before you put it back on. The leather handles have their own care instructions.
seo_title: Herringbone Dog Mattress with Faux Fur Top | Snoozly
seo_description: A soft pillow dog mattress with room to sprawl: faux-fur top, fibre filling and a grey herringbone outer. Medium or Large, with removable washable covers.
